nodes.label: Game availability during highscore loading and display
Running-game values
nodes.source: Finished run/level state and player identity input
nodes.untrusted_input: Score, survival time, and player name produced or supplied by the running game

nodes.label: Local highscore file
nodes.untrusted_input: Existing file contents that the user or local tampering may edit

nodes.label: External game content
nodes.sink: Running game state and eventual highscore recording
nodes.untrusted_input: Values loaded from outside the program, including shared level content

nodes.failure_behavior: Reject the invalid run and report the validation failure to the caller.
nodes.label: The highscore run-recording operation must accept only valid score, survival-time, and player-name values, reject and report invalid input, and must not substitute or clamp values inside that operation.
nodes.task_relevance: Protects the integrity of the real score, player name, and mm:ss survival time recorded at run completion.

nodes.failure_behavior: Use the defined defaults or normalized values, then perform the recording operation; do not skip recording.
nodes.label: The run-end integration point must normalize missing or invalid score, survival time, and player-name values to stated safe defaults before calling the highscore recording operation, so completing a run still produces a record.
nodes.task_relevance: Preserves the feature's primary effect when level or player data is malformed.

nodes.failure_behavior: Reject and report the malformed file contents without executing or interpreting them as objects or code.
nodes.label: The highscore store must parse the local file strictly as data, avoid Java object deserialization, and reject and report malformed, unexpected, or executable-looking content.
nodes.task_relevance: Prevents a user-editable persistence file from becoming a code-execution or record-tampering channel.

nodes.failure_behavior: Reject and report input exceeding any read or field limit.
nodes.label: Highscore file reads must be bounded by explicit limits on file size, record count, field lengths, and numeric ranges before parsing or retaining data.
nodes.task_relevance: Prevents malformed or hostile local files from consuming excessive memory or processing time.

nodes.failure_behavior: Reject and report an incoming record that cannot be retained under the bound; do not grow the collection beyond the limit.
nodes.label: The retained highscore collection must have a fixed maximum size and retain only records satisfying the store's validation rules, with ordering by descending score and deterministic handling of ties.
nodes.task_relevance: Bounds persistent state and ensures the displayed board reflects the required ranking.

nodes.failure_behavior: Report the load failure, substitute the safe board default, and continue rendering or running the game.
nodes.label: Malformed or unavailable highscore data must not prevent the game menu or running game from continuing; the caller must use an empty or otherwise stated safe board default while reporting the load failure.
nodes.task_relevance: Maintains game availability while preserving the highscore feature's display effect.

nodes.failure_behavior: Reject and report invalid input; never clamp or substitute it in the receiving operation.
nodes.label: Use a strict validation gate in the run-recording operation for score, survival time, and player name, returning an explicit rejection result or error for invalid values.
nodes.task_relevance: Enforces R1 at the operation receiving running-game input.

nodes.failure_behavior: Call the recording operation with normalized defaults and continue the record effect.
nodes.label: Normalize absent or invalid run-end values at the integration caller using explicit safe defaults before invoking the recording operation.
nodes.task_relevance: Enforces R2 while ensuring run completion still records a result.

nodes.failure_behavior: Reject and report malformed or disallowed data without executing it.
nodes.label: Implement a dedicated non-object-deserialization parser for the highscore file using an allowlisted data format and explicit field validation.
nodes.task_relevance: Enforces R3 for user-editable persistence data.

nodes.failure_behavior: Reject and report the first exceeded limit.
nodes.label: Read the store through a bounded stream or bounded byte/character buffer, enforcing file, field, record, and numeric limits before allocation or parsing.
nodes.task_relevance: Enforces R4 against oversized or resource-exhausting local files.

nodes.failure_behavior: Reject and report an entry that violates validation or retention bounds; never exceed the cap.
nodes.label: Use a bounded highscore collection that validates each record, sorts by descending score, applies deterministic tie ordering, and caps retained entries.
nodes.task_relevance: Enforces R5 for both newly recorded and loaded entries.

nodes.failure_behavior: Keep the game available, display the safe default board, and report the load failure.
nodes.label: Wrap store loading and menu-board preparation with explicit failure handling that reports errors and supplies an empty bounded board default.
nodes.task_relevance: Enforces R6 at the game integration point.

summary: Generic security context for a Java desktop game's persisted highscore feature; no repository inspection was performed.
